domain: GPU Cloud Infrastructure (H100/B200 Clusters & NVLink Fabric)
title: $18.4M Dedicated H100 Supercluster for Foundation Model Training - 512-GPU Reservation
executive_summary: Neocloud proposes a $18.4M 90-day dedicated reservation of 512x H100 GPUs for frontier LLM training starting December 1st. Technical review reveals material gaps between sales uptime, storage, and compliance promises and engineered delivery limits.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text:
We propose dedicated access to 512x NVIDIA H100 SXM 80GB GPUs across 64 nodes with NVLink and 3.2 Tbps InfiniBand NDR fabric, guaranteeing 99.99% uptime SLA with zero scheduled downtime and 400 GB/s bidirectional NVLink throughput per GPU for your 90-day LLM training run starting December 1st.

The solution includes unlimited checkpoint storage with instant sub-30-second recovery, SOC 2 Type II plus HIPAA-compliant isolated tenancy at no extra cost, and seamless burst scaling to 1024x B200 GPUs on demand within 5 minutes notice.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text:
The cluster provides 512x H100 SXM 80GB GPUs interconnected via NVLink 4.0 delivering up to 900 GB/s bidirectional throughput per GPU and 400 Gb/s NDR InfiniBand per node (3.2 Tbps aggregate per 8-node pod). Planned maintenance requires a 4-hour window every Sunday 02:00-06:00 UTC with 48-hour notice, during which compute availability is capped at 99.5% monthly, and customer workloads must checkpoint at least every 60 minutes.

Checkpoint storage is limited to 50TB per tenant with best-effort restore targeting 8-12 minutes RTO, single-tenant isolation available only as paid add-on with SOC 2 Type II attestation (HIPAA BAA requires Enterprise Plus tier). Burst scaling to B200 capacity is subject to availability pool and requires 14-day advance reservation with no guarantee of sub-30-day fulfillment during Q4 peak demand.

commitments.claim: 99.99% uptime SLA with zero scheduled downtime
commitments.proposal_quote: guaranteeing 99.99% uptime SLA with zero scheduled downtime
commitments.spec_quote: compute availability is capped at 99.5% monthly
commitments.explanation: Proposal promises near-perfect uptime with no maintenance impact, while spec mandates weekly 4-hour Sunday maintenance windows and caps availability at 99.5%, a direct mathematical contradiction that voids the SLA for a 90-day training run.

commitments.claim: Unlimited checkpoint storage with instant sub-30-second recovery
commitments.proposal_quote: unlimited checkpoint storage with instant sub-30-second recovery
commitments.explanation: Spec provides no support for unlimited capacity or sub-minute RTO; it explicitly limits tenants to 50TB and targets 8-12 minutes best-effort restore, leaving the sales recovery promise entirely unsubstantiated and risking catastrophic training loss.

commitments.claim: SOC 2 Type II plus HIPAA-compliant isolated tenancy at no extra cost
commitments.proposal_quote: SOC 2 Type II plus HIPAA-compliant isolated tenancy at no extra cost
commitments.spec_quote: single-tenant isolation available only as paid add-on with SOC 2 Type II attestation (HIPAA BAA requires Enterprise Plus tier)
commitments.explanation: Spec makes isolation a paid add-on and ties HIPAA BAA to Enterprise Plus tier, while proposal vaguely bundles it at no extra cost without defining tier scope, leaving uncertain whether compliance, isolation, or added fees apply.

commitments.claim: Dedicated access to 512x H100 SXM GPUs
commitments.proposal_quote: 512x NVIDIA H100 SXM 80GB GPUs across 64 nodes
commitments.spec_quote: The cluster provides 512x H100 SXM 80GB GPUs
commitments.explanation: Spec confirms the core capacity commitment of 512x H100 SXM 80GB GPUs, directly corroborating the proposal's node count and GPU model for the base reservation.
